name: Sigarda's Summons — "have base power and toughness 4/4, have flying, and are Angels in addition to their other types"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). The middle item of the list, "have flying", was dropped, and the base P/T was emitted twice (once by the type parser, once by the base-P/T parser). Grizzly Bears with a +1/+1 counter is a 5/5 flying Bear Angel through one base-P/T effect; Gray Ogre without a counter is untouched.
